_comment: Weekly training topics sourced from FMCSA (fmcsa.dot.gov). Add, remove, or reorder topics freely. 'key_points' become the slide outline. Always verify 'source_url' before sending, since FMCSA occasionally moves pages.

topics.title: Hours of Service (HOS)
